asr.text: Hey, Nix, raise the bedroom lights up.
Hey, Nix, raise the bedroom lights out.
Hey, Nix, read tomorrow's first calendar.
Hey, Nick, read tomorrow's first calendar.
Hey Nick, read tomorrow's first calendar entry.
Hey Nick, read tomorrow's first calendar engine.

policy: One boot per input, original C161 and exposed audio. Causal 16/48/16 kHz FIR and 10 ms RNNoise frames from sample zero. Crop only final zero padding. Release to the next 256-sample acquisition block. Opus uses that availability clock and filtered audio throughout. Separately report serialized guest service on the 256-sample capture schedule. No concurrent full-device timing. Min heap is boot-wide. Quiet uses the cue end rather than a command boundary. Raw Opus ASR is reused by hash.
